schema.text: Do you rarely use public transport because you feel unsafe on board or at stops (traffic, crime or harassment)?

ar.#Do you rarely use public transport beca: هل تعود قلّة استخدامك للنقل العام إلى شعور بعدم الأمان داخل المركبات أو في المحطات (حركة المرور أو الجرائم أو التحرش)؟

de.#Do you rarely use public transport beca: Nutzen Sie selten öffentliche Verkehrsmittel, weil Sie sich im Fahrzeug oder an Haltestellen unsicher fühlen (Verkehr, Kriminalität oder Belästigung)?

en.#Do you rarely use public transport beca: Do you rarely use public transport because you feel unsafe on board or at stops (traffic, crime or harassment)?

fa.#Do you rarely use public transport beca: آیا کم از حمل‌ونقل عمومی استفاده می‌کنید چون داخل وسیله یا در ایستگاه‌ها احساس امنیت نمی‌کنید (ترافیک، جرم یا آزار)؟

fr.#Do you rarely use public transport beca: Utilisez-vous rarement les transports en commun parce que vous ne vous sentez pas en sécurité à bord ou aux arrêts (circulation, délinquance ou harcèlement) ?

hu.#Do you rarely use public transport beca: Azért használja ritkán a tömegközlekedést, mert a járműveken vagy a megállókban nem érzi magát biztonságban (forgalom, bűncselekmények vagy zaklatás)?

it.#Do you rarely use public transport beca: Usi poco i mezzi pubblici perché a bordo o alle fermate non ti senti al sicuro (traffico, criminalità o molestie)?

tr.#Do you rarely use public transport beca: Araçta veya duraklarda kendinizi güvende hissetmediğiniz için mi (Trafik, suç veya taciz) toplu taşımayı nadiren kullanıyorsunuz?
